node.title: Re: Socket buffer errors
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I would strongly recommend against writing a HTTP server at such a low level. There are lots of ways to implement an HTTP server in Perl, and by now I've written quite a few that accept data from sensors and data loggers, I even gave a [https://youtu.be/V0GKykOCPzM|talk] on that kind of thing. In the past I've implemented them using modules such as [mod://HTTP::Server::Simple] (though I wouldn't really recommend that one anymore), [mod://CGI] or [mod://CGI::Fast] behind [man://lighttpd] (also somewhat outdated), [mod://Plack] (modern but relatively low-level), and [mod://POE] (fairly big learning curve), before finally settling on [mod://Mojolicious] as my favorite. If you look at the bottom of [id://830550|my scratchpad], you'll see I've linked a whole bunch of [mod://Mojolicious] example code I've posted here, and [mod://Mojolicious::Guides::Tutorial] is a good place to start.
